name: Roasted Broccoli
desc: Broccoli roasted with garlic, then tossed with lemon zest, lemon juice, and Parmesan.

source.title: Parmesan-Roasted Broccoli
source.evidence: Same broccoli prep, garlic, 5 tbsp plus 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, salt, pepper, lemon zest and juice, and Parmesan, nearly word for word; this version drops the pine nuts and basil and roasts at 400°F.

ingredients.raw: 4 garlic cloves, peeled and thinly sliced
6 1/2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, divided (or butter-flavor coconut oil for keto)
ingredients.note: or butter-flavor coconut oil for keto

steps: Cut the florets from the thick stalks, leaving an inch or two of stalk on each; discard the rest of the stalks. Cut the larger pieces through the base with a small knife and pull the florets apart. You should have about 8 cups.

Spread the florets on a sheet pan large enough to hold them in a single layer (use two if needed). Scatter the garlic over them, drizzle with 5 tbsp of the olive oil, and sprinkle with the salt and pepper.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes, until crisp-tender and some floret tips are browned.
Right away, toss with the remaining 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, the lemon zest, lemon juice, and Parmesan. Serve hot.
tips: Ina Garten roasts at 425°F and finishes with 3 tbsp toasted pine nuts and 2 tbsp julienned basil.
